utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes — I’ve got the supplies list covered and I’ll keep it updated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, send it my way and I’ll help spread it around to folks I hear from.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — I’ll send it over soon. And if you hear anyone with tools or a truck, send them my way too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies and send you a short list of anything we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just send me the list and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check what we have and send you a brief missing-supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll bring the drill and extra screws, and I’ll lock in Saturday 9 to 11.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Leo — that works great. I’ll have the rest of the tools ready, and we can use Saturday 9 to 11 to get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Gus — see you Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m already tracking who needs what, and I’ll bring it to the next block meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there and ready to help. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — if you can bring any tools, gloves, or a truck, that would be a big help. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking — is the repair drive still on?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s still on — I’m starting with the Maple Street folks, then I’ll loop in the community center about supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — can you confirm the pickup time too?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess — if you hear anything, please tell me the start time, the first house, and anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the start time, first house, and anything to bring as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still piecing it together, but once I’m back from errands I’ll let you know what needs doing. Mostly I’ll need help moving the broken stuff and keeping an eye on what gets dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds good — once you’re back, start with Maple Street so the tools are handy, then have the community center line up supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll start with Maple Street when I’m back and then check in with the community center about supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’m still keeping it pretty low-key, but if you could help sort a few supplies, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — point me to the supplies and I’ll sort them quick.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ve got a small box by the porch with the screws and tape, and the rest is in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning from 9 to 11 still works for me around school—go ahead and lock it in, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, Saturday 9 to 11 is locked in. Thanks, Faye — I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Faye — could you check who’s signed up and whether we still need any gloves or screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — just let me know when the details are ready, and I’ll repeat the plan and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m still checking the final details, but I’ll get you the date, time, and drop-off spot as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — once you’ve got the date, time, and drop-off spot, send them my way and I’ll repeat the plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and come by after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mina — I’ll send the exact details as soon as I have them, and we’d love to see you there after your errands!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — just send them when you can, and I’ll plan to stop by after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I still need the exact pickup time and destination first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll add you right now and send the details when they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll bring screws, tape, and a screwdriver, and I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors too. We’ve got this.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can sort the donated tools and set aside anything that needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — I still need the pickup time and where everything’s headed before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can get that from Gus and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Kira — I’ve got the tools ready, and I can walk you through the repair drive details. What part do you want to help with?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the repair drive still on? I’m mainly waiting on the pickup time and where it’s headed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, it’s still on — pickup is at 10 a.m. by the community center, and we’re headed to the east lot. I’ll sort out the rest of the details with you now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 9 and we can start with the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes please — a quick version would be great, and I’m still checking on the date, time, and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep it quick and send along the date, time, and drop-off spot as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on—I’m just confirming one last detail before I lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—send me the last detail when you have it, and I’ll repeat the plan to everyone who needs it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m checking one last detail now, then I’ll send the full confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — we’re still on for the repair drive this weekend. Can you come by around 9 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, 9 a.m. works — I’ll swing by after my errands and help with the broken stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — thanks, Ira. See you at 9 a.m. and I’ll have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ve still got that tape and a few screws in the garage. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — that should help. What time are we starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a little fuzzy on the time — did we settle on this afternoon? If not, just tell me when and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning from 9 to 11 still works for me around school. Go ahead and lock it in, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll lock in Saturday from 9 to 11 and send out the invite with the details. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — I’ll share it with the school folks and keep an eye out for anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of who needs what and bring it to the next block meeting.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara. That would really help—I'll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — send anything my way, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m ready to start at 10 a.m. at the community shed with gloves, water, and my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 10 a.m. at the community shed. Thanks for setting everything up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll start us at the shed at 10, and we can go house by house from the first one down the street.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely—I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. If you send me the missing supplies list, I’ll keep an ear out for anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell — I’ll send the missing supplies list over. A drill and extra screws are the main things we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for a drill and extra screws and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Opal — I’ll jot down the biggest issues and where they’re showing up so we can tackle the urgent ones first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s the right start — once you have the list, I can help sort the locations and point you to the fastest responders.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Opal — I’ll get the list together and bring it to you so we can match each issue with the right help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a huge help, Bo — bring whatever tape, screws, or tools you can find. I’ll keep asking around for a truck and a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll grab tape, screws, and a few tools and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — that’s perfect. I’ll keep lining up a truck and a couple extra hands, and we’ll compare notes soon.
